v.t: Successful are the believers
v.l: Qad 'Aflaha Al-Mu'uminuna

v.t: Those who are humble in their prayers
v.l: Al-Ladhina Hum Fi Salatihim Khashi`una

v.t: Those who avoid nonsense
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Hum `Ani Al-Laghwi Mu`riđuna

v.t: Those who work for charity
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Hum Lilzzakaati Fa`iluna

v.t: Those who safeguard their chastity
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Hum Lifurujihim Hafizuna

v.t: Except from their spouses, or their dependents—for then they are free from blame
v.l: Illa `Ala 'Azwajihim 'W Ma Malakat 'Aymanuhum Fa'innahum Ghayru Malumina

v.t: But whoever seeks anything beyond that—these are the transgressors
v.l: Famani Abtagha Wara'a Dhalika Fa'ula'ika Humu Al-`Aduna

v.t: Those who are faithful to their trusts and pledges
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Hum Li'manatihim Wa `Ahdihim Ra`una

v.t: Those who safeguard their prayers
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Hum `Ala Salawatihim Yuhafizuna

v.t: These are the inheritors
v.l: Ula'ika Humu Al-Warithuna

v.t: Who will inherit Paradise, wherein they will dwell forever
v.l: Al-Ladhina Yarithuna Al-Firdawsa Hum Fiha Khaliduna

v.t: We created man from an extract of clay
v.l: Wa Laqad Khalaqna Al-'Insana Min Sulalatin Min Tinin

v.t: Then We made him a seed, in a secure repository
v.l: Thumma Ja`alnahu Nutfatan Fi Qararin Makinin

v.t: Then We developed the seed into a clot. Then We developed the clot into a lump. Then We developed the lump into bones. Then We clothed the bones with flesh. Then We produced it into another creature. Most Blessed is God, the Best of Creators
v.l: Thumma Khalaqna An-Nutfata `Alaqatan Fakhalaqna Al-`Alaqata Muđghatan Fakhalaqna Al-Muđghata `Izamaan Fakasawna Al-`Izama Lahmaan Thumma 'Ansha'nahu Khalqaan 'Akhara Fatabaraka Allahu 'Ahsanu Al-Khaliqina

v.t: Then, after that, you will die
v.l: Thumma 'Innakum Ba`da Dhalika Lamayyituna

v.t: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be resurrected
v.l: Thumma 'Innakum Yawma Al-Qiyamati Tub`athuna

v.t: We created above you seven pathways, and We are never heedless of the creation
v.l: Wa Laqad Khalaqna Fawqakum Sab`a Tara'iqa Wa Ma Kunna `Ani Al-Khalqi Ghafilina

v.t: And We sent down water from the sky in proper quantity, and settled it in the ground, and We are Able to take it away
v.l: Wa 'Anzalna Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Biqadarin Fa'askannahu Fi Al-'Arđi Wa 'Inna `Ala Dhahabin Bihi Laqadiruna
w: then We cause it to settle

v.t: With it We produce for you gardens of palms and vines, yielding abundant fruit for you to eat
v.l: Fa'ansha'na Lakum Bihi Jannatin Min Nakhilin Wa 'A`nabin Lakum Fiha Fawakihu Kathiratun Wa Minha Ta'kuluna

v.t: And a tree springing out of Mount Sinai, producing oil, and seasoning for those who eat
v.l: Wa Shajaratan Takhruju Min Turi Sayna'a Tanbutu Bid-Duhni Wa Sibghin Lil'akilina

v.t: And there is a lesson for you in livestock: We give you to drink from what is in their bellies, and you have many benefits in them, and from them you eat
v.l: Wa 'Inna Lakum Fi Al-'An`ami La`ibratan Nusqikum Mimma Fi Butuniha Wa Lakum Fiha Manafi`u Kathiratun Wa Minha Ta'kuluna

v.t: And on them, and on the ships, you are transported
v.l: Wa `Alayha Wa `Ala Al-Fulki Tuhmaluna

v.t: We sent Noah to his people. He said, “O my people, worship God, you have no deity other than Him. Will you not take heed?”
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Arsalna Nuhaan 'Ila Qawmihi Faqala Ya Qawmi A`budu Allaha Ma Lakum Min 'Ilahin Ghayruhu 'Afala Tattaquna

v.t: But the notables of his people, who disbelieved, said, “This is nothing but a human like you, who wants to gain superiority over you. Had God willed, He would have sent down angels. We never heard of this from our forefathers of old
v.l: Faqala Al-Mala'u Al-Ladhina Kafaru Min Qawmihi Ma Hadha 'Illa Basharun Mithlukum Yuridu 'An Yatafađđala `Alaykum Wa Law Sha'a Allahu La'anzala Mala'ikatan Ma Sami`na Bihadha Fi 'Aba'ina Al-'Awwalina

v.t: He is nothing but a man possessed. Just ignore him for a while.”
v.l: In Huwa 'Illa Rajulun Bihi Jinnatun Fatarabbasu Bihi Hatta Hinin

v.t: He said, “My Lord, help me, for they have rejected me.”
v.l: Qala Rabbi Ansurni Bima Kadhabuni

v.t: So We inspired him: “Build the Ark under Our observation and by Our inspiration. And when Our decree comes to pass, and the oven boils over, load into it two pairs of every kind, together with your family, except those of them against whom the word has already been pronounced. And do not speak to me concerning those who did wrong; for they are to be drowned.”
v.l: Fa'awhayna 'Ilayhi 'Ani Asna`i Al-Fulka Bi'a`yunina Wa Wahyina Fa'idha Ja'a 'Amruna Wa Fara At-Tannuru Fasluk Fiha Min Kullin Zawjayni Athnayni Wa 'Ahlaka 'Illa Man Sabaqa `Alayhi Al-Qawlu Minhum Wa La Tukhatibni Fi Al-Ladhina Zalamu 'Innahum Mughraquna

v.t: Then, when you and those with you are settled in the Ark, say, “Praise be to God, who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.”
v.l: Fa'idha Astawayta 'Anta Wa Man Ma`aka `Ala Al-Fulki Faquli Al-Hamdu Lillahi Al-Ladhi Najjana Mina Al-Qawmi Az-Zalimina

v.t: And say, “My Lord, land me with a blessed landing, as you are the best of transporters.”
v.l: Wa Qul Rabbi 'Anzilni Munzalaan Mubarakaan Wa 'Anta Khayru Al-Munzilina

v.t: Surely in that are signs. We are always testing
v.l: Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Wa 'In Kunna Lamubtalina

v.t: Then, after them, We established another generation
v.l: Thumma 'Ansha'na Min Ba`dihim Qarnaan 'Akharina

v.t: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves: “Serve God. You have no god other than Him. Will you not be cautious?”
v.l: Fa'arsalna Fihim Rasulaan Minhum 'Ani A`budu Allaha Ma Lakum Min 'Ilahin Ghayruhu 'Afala Tattaquna

v.t: But the dignitaries of his people, those who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and We had indulged them in the present life, said, “This is nothing but a human like you; he eats what you eat, and he drinks what you drink
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Mala'u Min Qawmihi Al-Ladhina Kafaru Wa Kadhabu Biliqa'i Al-'Akhirati Wa 'Atrafnahum Fi Al-Hayaati Ad-Dunya Ma Hadha 'Illa Basharun Mithlukum Ya'kulu Mimma Ta'kuluna Minhu Wa Yashrabu Mimma Tashrabuna
w: while We had given them luxury

v.t: If you obey a human being like yourselves, then you will be losers
v.l: Wa La'in 'Ata`tum Basharaan Mithlakum 'Innakum 'Idhaan Lakhasiruna

v.t: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones, you will be brought out
v.l: Aya`idukum 'Annakum 'Idha Mittum Wa Kuntum Turabaan Wa `Izamaan 'Annakum Mukhrajuna

v.t: Farfetched, farfetched is what you are promised
v.l: Hayhata Hayhata Lima Tu`aduna

v.t: There is nothing but our life in this world. We die, and we live, and we are not resurrected
v.l: In Hiya 'Illa Hayatuna Ad-Dunya Namutu Wa Nahya Wa Ma Nahnu Bimab`uthina

v.t: He is nothing but a man, making up lies about God. We have no faith in him.”
v.l: In Huwa 'Illa Rajulun Aftara `Ala Allahi Kadhibaan Wa Ma Nahnu Lahu Bimu'uminina

v.t: He said, “My Lord, help me, for they have rejected me.”
v.l: Qala Rabbi Ansurni Bima Kadhabuni

v.t: He said, “Soon they will be filled with regret.”
v.l: Qala `Amma Qalilin Layusbihunna Nadimina

v.t: Then the Blast struck them, justifiably, and We turned them into scum. So away with the wicked people
v.l: Fa'akhadhat/humu As-Sayhatu Bil-Haqqi Faja`alnahum Ghutha'an Fabu`daan Lilqawmi Az-Zalimina

v.t: Then, after them, We raised other generations
v.l: Thumma 'Ansha'na Min Ba`dihim Qurunaan 'Akharina

v.t: No nation can advance its time, nor can they postpone it
v.l: Ma Tasbiqu Min 'Ummatin 'Ajalaha Wa Ma Yasta'khiruna

v.t: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time a messenger came to his community, they called him a liar. So We made them follow one another, and made them history. So away with a people who do not believe
v.l: Thumma 'Arsalna Rusulana Tatra Kulla Ma Ja'a 'Ummatan Rasuluha Kadhabuhu Fa'atba`na Ba`đahum Ba`đaan Wa Ja`alnahum 'Ahaditha Fabu`daan Liqawmin La Yu'uminuna

v.t: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our signs and a clear authority
v.l: Thumma 'Arsalna Musa Wa 'Akhahu Haruna Bi'ayatina Wa Sultanin Mubinin

v.t: To Pharaoh and his nobles, but they turned arrogant. They were oppressive people
v.l: Ila Fir`awna Wa Mala'ihi Fastakbaru Wa Kanu Qawmaan `Alina

v.t: They said, “Are we to believe in two mortals like us, and their people are our slaves?”
v.l: Faqalu 'Anu'uminu Libasharayni Mithlina Wa Qawmuhuma Lana `Abiduna

v.t: So they called them liars, and thus were among those destroyed
v.l: Fakadhabuhuma Fakanu Mina Al-Muhlakina

v.t: And We gave Moses the Scripture, that they may be guided
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Atayna Musa Al-Kitaba La`allahum Yahtaduna

v.t: And We made Mary’s son and his mother a sign, and We sheltered them on high ground with security and flowing springs
v.l: Wa Ja`alna Abna Maryama Wa 'Ummahu 'Ayatan Wa 'Awaynahuma 'Ila Rabwatin Dhati Qararin Wa Ma`inin

v.t: O messengers, eat of the good things, and act with integrity. I am aware of what you do
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha Ar-Rusulu Kulu Mina At-Tayyibati Wa A`malu Salihaan 'Inni Bima Ta`maluna `Alimun

v.t: This nation of yours is one nation, and I am your Lord, so fear Me
v.l: Wa 'Inna Hadhihi 'Ummatukum 'Ummatan Wahidatan Wa 'Ana Rabbukum Fa Attaquni

v.t: But they tore themselves into sects; each party happy with what they have
v.l: Fataqatta`u 'Amrahum Baynahum Zuburaan Kullu Hizbin Bima Ladayhim Farihuna

v.t: So leave them in their bewilderment until a time
v.l: Fadharhum Fi Ghamratihim Hatta Hinin

v.t: Do they assume that, in furnishing them with wealth and children
v.l: Ayahsabuna 'Annama Numidduhum Bihi Min Malin Wa Banina

v.t: We race to give them the good things? In fact, they have no idea
v.l: Nusari`u Lahum Fi Al-Khayrati Bal La Yash`uruna

v.t: Those who, from awe of their Lord, are fearful
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina Hum Min Khashyati Rabbihim Mushfiquna

v.t: And those who believe in their Lord’s Verses
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Hum Bi'ayati Rabbihim Yu'uminuna

v.t: And those who associate no partners with their Lord
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Hum Birabbihim La Yushrikuna

v.t: And those who give what they give, while their hearts quake, knowing that to their Lord they will return
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Yu'utuna Ma 'Ataw Wa Qulubuhum Wa Jilatun 'Annahum 'Ila Rabbihim Raji`una

v.t: It is they who race towards goodness. It is they who will reach it first
v.l: Ula'ika Yusari`una Fi Al-Khayrati Wa Hum Laha Sabiquna

v.t: We never burden any soul beyond its capacity. And with Us is a record that tells the truth, and they will not be wronged
v.l: Wa La Nukallifu Nafsaan 'Illa Wus`aha Wa Ladayna Kitabun Yantiqu Bil-Haqqi Wa Hum La Yuzlamun

v.t: But their hearts are puzzled because of this; and they have deeds that do not conform to this, which they continue to perpetrate
v.l: Bal Qulubuhum Fi Ghamratin Min Hadha Wa Lahum 'A`malun Min Duni Dhalika Hum Laha `Amiluna

v.t: Until, when We seize the decadent among them with torment, they begin to groan
v.l: Hatta 'Idha 'Akhadhna Mutrafihim Bil-`Adhabi 'Idha Hum Yaj'aruna

v.t: Do not groan today. You will receive no help from Us
v.l: La Taj'aru Al-Yawma 'Innakum Minna La Tunsaruna

v.t: My Verses were recited to you, but you turned back on your heels
v.l: Qad Kanat 'Ayati Tutla `Alaykum Fakuntum `Ala 'A`qabikum Tankisuna

v.t: Arrogant towards it—talked nonsense about it—disregarded it
v.l: Mustakbirina Bihi Samiraan Tahjuruna

v.t: Have they not pondered the Word? Or has there come to them what came not to their forefathers of old
v.l: Afalam Yaddabbaru Al-Qawla 'Am Ja'ahum Ma Lam Ya'ti 'Aba'ahumu Al-'Awwalina

v.t: Or is it that they did not recognize their messenger, so they are denying him
v.l: Am Lam Ya`rifu Rasulahum Fahum Lahu Munkiruna

v.t: Or do they say, “He is possessed?” In fact, he brought them the truth, but most of them hate the truth
v.l: Am Yaquluna Bihi Jinnatun Bal Ja'ahum Bil-Haqqi Wa 'Aktharuhum Lilhaqqi Karihuna

v.t: If the truth conformed to their desires, the heavens, the earth, and everyone in them would have gone to ruin. In fact, We have given them their message, but they keep avoiding their message
v.l: Wa Lawi Attaba`a Al-Haqqu 'Ahwa'ahum Lafasadati As-Samawatu Wa Al-'Arđu Wa Man Fihinna Bal 'Ataynahum Bidhikrihim Fahum `An Dhikrihim Mu`riđuna

v.t: Or are you asking them for a payment? The revenue from your Lord is better, and He is the Best of providers
v.l: Am Tas'aluhum Kharjaan Fakharaju Rabbika Khayrun Wa Huwa Khayru Ar-Raziqina

v.t: You are inviting them to a straight path
v.l: Wa 'Innaka Latad`uhum 'Ila Siratin Mustaqimin

v.t: But those who do not believe in the Hereafter are swerving from the path
v.l: Wa 'Inna Al-Ladhina La Yu'uminuna Bil-'Akhirati `Ani As-Sirati Lanakibuna

v.t: Even if We had mercy on them, and relieved their problems, they would still blindly persist in their defiance
v.l: Wa Law Rahimnahum Wa Kashafna Ma Bihim Min Đurrin Lalajju Fi Tughyanihim Ya`mahuna

v.t: We have already gripped them with suffering, but they did not surrender to their Lord, nor did they humble themselves
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Akhadhnahum Bil-`Adhabi Fama Astakanu Lirabbihim Wa Ma Yatađarra`una

v.t: Until, when We have opened before them a gate of intense agony, at once they will despair
v.l: Hatta 'Idha Fatahna `Alayhim Babaan Dha `Adhabin Shadidin 'Idha Hum Fihi Mublisuna

v.t: It is He who produced for you the hearing, and the eyesight, and the feelings. But little gratitude you show
v.l: Wa Huwa Al-Ladhi 'Ansha'a Lakumu As-Sam`a Wa Al-'Absara Wa Al-'Af'idata Qalilaan Ma Tashkuruna

v.t: And it is He who multiplied you on earth, and to Him you will be gathered
v.l: Wa Huwa Al-Ladhi Dhara'akum Fi Al-'Arđi Wa 'Ilayhi Tuhsharuna

v.t: And it is He who gives life and brings death, and to Him is the alternation of night and day. Do you not understand
v.l: Wa Huwa Al-Ladhi Yuhyi Wa Yumitu Wa Lahu Akhtilafu Al-Layli Wa An-Nahari 'Afala Ta`qiluna

v.t: But they say the like of what the ancients said
v.l: Bal Qalu Mithla Ma Qala Al-'Awwaluna

v.t: They say, “After we have died, and become dust and bones, will we be resurrected
v.l: Qalu 'A'idha Mitna Wa Kunna Turabaan Wa `Izamaan 'A'inna Lamab`uthuna

v.t: We were promised this before—we and our ancestors—these are nothing but legends of the ancients.”
v.l: Laqad Wu`idna Nahnu Wa 'Aba'uuna Hadha Min Qablu 'In Hadha 'Illa 'Asatiru Al-'Awwalina

v.t: Say, “To whom does the earth belong, and everyone in it, if you happen to know?”
v.l: Qul Limani Al-'Arđu Wa Man Fiha 'In Kuntum Ta`lamuna

v.t: They will say, “To God.” Say, “Will you not reflect?”
v.l: Sayaquluna Lillahi Qul 'Afala Tadhakkaruna

v.t: Say, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Splendid Throne?”
v.l: Qul Man Rabbu As-Samawati As-Sab`i Wa Rabbu Al-`Arshi Al-`Azimi

v.t: They will say, “To God.” Say, “Will you not become righteous?”
v.l: Sayaquluna Lillahi Qul 'Afala Tattaquna

v.t: Say, “In whose hand is the dominion of all things, and He protects and cannot be protected from, if you happen to know?”
v.l: Qul Man Biyadihi Malakutu Kulli Shay'in Wa Huwa Yujiru Wa La Yujaru `Alayhi 'In Kuntum Ta`lamun

v.t: They will say, “To God.” Say, “Then are you bewitched?”
v.l: Sayaquluna Lillahi Qul Fa'anna Tusharuna

v.t: In fact, We have given them the truth, and they are liars
v.l: Bal 'Ataynahum Bil-Haqqi Wa 'Innahum Lakadhibuna

v.t: God has never begotten a son, nor is there any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have taken away what it has created, and some of them would have gained supremacy over others. Glory be to God, far beyond what they describe
v.l: Ma Attakhadha Allahu Min Waladin Wa Ma Kana Ma`ahu Min 'Ilahin 'Idhaan Ladhahaba Kullu 'Ilahin Bima Khalaqa Wa La`ala Ba`đuhum `Ala Ba`đin Subhana Allahi `Amma Yasifuna

v.t: The Knower of the hidden and the manifest. He is exalted, far above what they associate
v.l: Alimi Al-Ghaybi Wa Ash-Shahadati Fata`ala `Amma Yushrikuna

v.t: Say, “My Lord, if You would show me what they are promised
v.l: Qul Rabbi 'Imma Turiyanni Ma Yu`aduna

v.t: My Lord, do not place me among the wicked people.”
v.l: Rabbi Fala Taj`alni Fi Al-Qawmi Az-Zalimina

v.t: We are surely Able to show you what We promise them
v.l: Wa 'Inna `Ala 'An Nuriyaka Ma Na`iduhum Laqadiruna

v.t: Repel evil by what is better. We are aware of what they describe
v.l: Idfa` Bi-Ati Hiya 'Ahsanu As-Sayyi'ata Nahnu 'A`lamu Bima Yasifuna

v.t: And say, “My Lord, I seek refuge with You from the urgings of the devils
v.l: Wa Qul Rabbi 'A`udhu Bika Min Hamazati Ash-Shayatini

v.t: And I seek refuge with You, my Lord, lest they become present.”
v.l: Wa 'A`udhu Bika Rabbi 'An Yahđuruni

v.t: Until, when death comes to one of them, he says, “My Lord, send me back
v.l: Hatta 'Idha Ja'a 'Ahadahumu Al-Mawtu Qala Rabbi Arji`uni

v.t: That I may do right in what I have neglected.” By no means! It is just a word that he utters. And behind them is a barrier, until the Day they are resurrected
v.l: La`alli 'A`malu Salihaan Fima Taraktu Kalla 'Innaha Kalimatun Huwa Qa'iluha Wa Min Wara'ihim Barzakhun 'Ila Yawmi Yub`athuna

v.t: When the Horn is blown, no relations between them will exist on that Day, and they will not ask after one another
v.l: Fa'idha Nufikha Fi As-Suri Fala 'Ansaba Baynahum Yawma'idhin Wa La Yatasa'aluna

v.t: Those whose scales are heavy—those are the successful
v.l: Faman Thaqulat Mawazinuhu Fa'ula'ika Humu Al-Muflihuna

v.t: But those whose scales are light—those are they who have lost their souls; in Hell they will dwell forever
v.l: Wa Man Khaffat Mawazinuhu Fa'ula'ika Al-Ladhina Khasiru 'Anfusahum Fi Jahannama Khaliduna

v.t: The Fire lashes their faces, and therein they grimace
v.l: Talfahu Wujuhahumu An-Naru Wa Hum Fiha Kalihuna

v.t: “Were not My revelations recited to you, and you kept on rejecting them?”
v.l: Alam Takun 'Ayati Tutla `Alaykum Fakuntum Biha Tukadhibuna

v.t: They will say, “Our Lord, our wretchedness prevailed over us, and we were a people astray
v.l: Qalu Rabbana Ghalabat `Alayna Shiqwatuna Wa Kunna Qawmaan Đallina

v.t: Our Lord! Bring us out of this. If we ever returned, we would truly be evil.”
v.l: Rabbana 'Akhrijna Minha Fa'in `Udna Fa'inna Zalimuna

v.t: He will say, “Be despised therein, and do not speak to Me
v.l: Qala Akhsa'u Fiha Wa La Tukallimuni

v.t: There was a group of My servants who would say, `Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us, and have mercy on us; You are the Best of the merciful
v.l: Innahu Kana Fariqun Min `Ibadi Yaquluna Rabbana 'Amanna Faghfir Lana Wa Arhamna Wa 'Anta Khayru Ar-Rahimina

v.t: But you made then a target of ridicule, until they made you forget My remembrance; and you used to laugh at them
v.l: Fattakhadhtumuhum Sikhriyaan Hatta 'Ansawkum Dhikri Wa Kuntum Minhum Tađhakuna

v.t: Today, I have rewarded them for their endurance. They are the ones who are the triumphant.”
v.l: Inni Jazaytuhumu Al-Yawma Bima Sabaru 'Annahum Humu Al-Fa'izuna

v.t: He will say, “How many years did you remain on earth?”
v.l: Qala Kam Labithtum Fi Al-'Arđi `Adada Sinina

v.t: They will say, “We remained a day, or part of a day; but ask those who keep count.”
v.l: Qalu Labithna Yawmaan 'Aw Ba`đa Yawmin Fas'ali Al-`Addina

v.t: He will say, “You remained only for a little while, if you only knew
v.l: Qala 'In Labithtum 'Illa Qalilaan Law 'Annakum Kuntum Ta`lamuna

v.t: Did you think that We created you in vain, and that to Us you will not be returned?”
v.l: Afahasibtum 'Annama Khalaqnakum `Abathaan Wa 'Annakum 'Ilayna La Turja`una

v.t: So Exalted is God, the Ruler, the Real. There is no god except He, the Lord of the Noble Throne
v.l: Fata`ala Allahu Al-Maliku Al-Haqqu La 'Ilaha 'Illa Huwa Rabbu Al-`Arshi Al-Karimi

v.t: Whoever invokes another god besides God—he has no proof thereof—his reckoning rests with his Lord. The disbelievers will not succeed
v.l: Wa Man Yad`u Ma`a Allahi 'Ilahaan 'Akhara La Burhana Lahu Bihi Fa'innama Hisabuhu `Inda Rabbihi 'Innahu La Yuflihu Al-Kafiruna

v.t: And say, “My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of the merciful.”
v.l: Wa Qul Rabbi Aghfir Wa Arham Wa 'Anta Khayru Ar-Rahimina
